summary: Modules that put your key into one language: they explain a word in it, or translate a sentence into it.

steps.title: Reads your key in any language
steps.text: It finds the key's language in the key itself, and decides whether it is a word or a sentence.

steps.title: Writes the core in its language
steps.text: A word's meanings, or a sentence's translation. A key already in that language is explained, not translated.

steps.title: Facets describe its translation
steps.text: Not your key. Each module has its own facets, in its own order, and leaves out those that do not apply.
